# SQLite 3.54.0 Lexer Fixtures

`sqlite-3.54.0-tokenizer.tsv` contains raw-token vectors generated by
`sqlite3GetToken` from the pinned SQLite 3.54.0 amalgamation at Fossil check-in
`65ec11f05a9ee5b23495427ece76c0550a8ffc28980a8a0c72d556ba0d2290e2`.

The oracle was compiled as one C translation unit that included the pinned
`sqlite3.c`, disabled threads and loadable extensions, decoded one hexadecimal
input per line, and repeatedly called `sqlite3GetToken` until physical end or
the first NUL. Generated `parse.h` codes were translated to Modern SQLite's
stable descriptive token names. The synthetic `end_of_input` vector records
the parser-facing logical end and is not a Lemon token.

The 348 cases cover:

- representative SQL and every punctuation or operator spelling;
- SQLite whitespace, BOMs, comments, quoted forms, numbers, blobs, and
  variables;
- malformed boundaries and malformed UTF-8 bytes;
- all 147 keywords active in the pinned default build in upper and lower case;
- `TRUE`, `FALSE`, and feature-disabled `WITHIN` identifier behavior;
- embedded NUL termination; and
- every nonzero single-byte input.

Each data row is:

```text
case-name<TAB>input-hex-or--<TAB>token-name@offset:length,...
```

`-` denotes an empty input. Offsets and lengths are bytes. The header records
the authenticated amalgamation digest used for generation.
